question: Where was the Yonex-Sunrise 47th Inter State - Inter Zonal & Junior National Badminton Championships 2024 held?
solution: The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar, Odisha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Yonex-Sunrise 47th Inter State - Inter Zonal & Junior National Badminton Championships 2024** was held in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, a city well-known for hosting major sporting events and promoting badminton at the grassroots level. • **Bhubaneswar** is a key hub for sports in India, with infrastructure such as **Kalinga Stadium**, which frequently hosts national and international sporting events. • The event featured participation from various state and zonal teams across India, bringing together **young badminton players** to compete at a high level of intensity and skill. • This championship is vital for nurturing and identifying **future badminton talents** in India, contributing to the development of the sport nationally. •
